title: Abstract, Presentation to the Scientific Counsel of GEPAN of Studies Undertaken During the First Semester of 1978: French Government UFO Study, June 1, 1978
doc_notes: This document is an abstract of a 1978 French GEPAN report on UFO investigations, submitted by Ron Westrum.

incidents.summary: Two nocturnal light cases investigated by GEPAN during 1977.
incidents.quote: it did study two nocturnal light cases, both of which ended up labelled “unidentified”
